# Introduction If you are interested in the setting of the Blimpuf server, or looking for information about the world to help fit your character into this expansive universe, this will act as an in-character handbook your character received after being hired by NanoTrasen.
Keep in mind that the hiring process involves being screened by CentCom before being allowed to work or transfer to this sector to begin work. Additional screenings are done by NanoTrasen to finalize hirings and begin assignments to specific jobs.
